title: Great tour of Montserrat and the winery
text: MARCEL was awesome in every way. Pick up, drop off went smooth and safe. His knowledge of the area and his accomodation of all our needs was flawless. The trip to the Vins de CEP was a special highlight especially the tour with Julia. Mucho gracias todos
author: _J7589WI

title: Fun day exploring Montserrat plus a cava vineyard
text: This was a great full day tour- first a few hours at Montserrat with our very knowledgeable guide Gaspar, including an hour or so on our own for exploring the museum and a liqueur tasting and a short hike, plus a few hours at a lovely cava vineyard plus tasting. Very happy we took a day out of our vacation to do this.
author: Allyson_H

title: The perfect escape from Barcelona
text: Gaspar was an exceptional guide for our day trip! He was friendly, incredibly knowledgeable, and attentive to everyone’s needs throughout the day. The itinerary struck a wonderful balance, it allowed us to relax and explore at our own pace while ensuring we didn't miss any of the highlights. Montserrat is a breathtaking destination, especially if you love nature and scenic views. Highly recommended for anyone visiting Barcelona who has an extra day to explore the surrounding area!
author: idash

title: Best guide experience!
text: Gaspar was the best guide! He picked us up at our hotel at the exact time he said he would and he was full of information about Barcelona and the Catalon region. He made sure we had all the information we needed before leaving us to explore on our own at Montserrat and then was waiting for us in time to get us to our wine tasting at Vins El Cep vineyards. Would highly recommend him for your next tour in and around the Barcelona region!
author: Susie98Boston

title: Montserrat
text: Albert was our guide. Great communicator, excellent professional. Knowledgeable about the content. He made for a pleasant and different day. My congratulations. Highly recommended

title: Magic in Montserrat.
text: Good morning, the guide Albert has been excellent. I recommend it. He is a very good communicator and provides a lot of information about the places we visited. Open to questions. Pleasant and respectful treatment. I congratulate him. Greetings.
author: inmaculadamar_aa2026

title: An enjoyable wine tasting and Monserrat tour
text: Marcel our guide picked us up at our hotel punctually. The mini bus was clean and comfortable. Marcel was a mine of interesting information and bursting with enthusiasm. We enjoyed the wine tour and despite the queues Marcel enabled us to reach Monserrat via the train in a timely fashion. The views were spectacular. The whole day was most enjoyable. Many thanks to Marcel.
author: gairney

title: Beautiful day
text: Incredible day to see a vineyard and Monserrat! Marcel took excellent care of all of us! Lunch and coffee options are available at Monserrat. I loved the hotel pick up and drop off option! It is a long day so have a good breakfast and maybe pack a water or snack if needed. Also, it gets colder in the mountains than in town so keep that in mind too if you need to bring a jacket. I chose not to and ended up buying a hoodie at the gift shop in the mountains. I loved that the option was there, but just a heads up for others.
